# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c28 P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is described as plain.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Jane is a gamely determined, unshakeable, plodding, and conscientious girl who possesses steady nerves and is not easily rattled. She holds definite opinions, such as believing that puffed sleeves are too worldly for a minister's wife, and she is easily impressed by glimpses into high society.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c30 P36](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0036), [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## History

Jane grew up in Avonlea as part of the local school group. During a boat row on the Lake of Shining Waters, she nearly fell overboard while picking water lilies, but her father saved her by catching her sash. She spent leisure time with friends like Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Ruby Gillis, participating in school dialogues and play afternoons. When schoolmaster Mr. Phillips departed, despite asserting she would never cry, she wept heavily and had to borrow her brother's handkerchief. She joined Miss Stacy's Queen's preparation class to study for a teaching career, expressing a intent to teach her whole life and never marry due to financial independence. Upon studying at Queen's Academy, she earned top honors in the domestic science course.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c28 P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_
